features.name: WASM tree-sitter over native bindings for cross-platform
features.counter_case: WASM adds 10-20ms cold-start overhead vs native bindings; native is 2x faster for large files. Acceptable tradeoff for first-install UX.

features.name: Security scan git diff and git log content for secrets, not just files
features.counter_case: Diff/log scanning increases Phase 7.10's surface area and runtime. Devs may disable security check to avoid the extra latency. Gate behind existing enableSecurityCheck flag.

features.name: tokenCountTree: per-directory token budget tree with minimum threshold
features.counter_case: Another display mode adds surface area to `build_context_pack`. Keep optional; users who don't need it won't miss it.

features.name: MCP grep tool with context lines on packed output (grep_knowledge)
features.counter_case: Cortex has cortex_find (fuzzy) and source (AST). grep_knowledge is redundant for indexed entities. Only useful for entity bodies not yet synthesized.

features.name: Atomic cache save: tmp+pid+random → rename to prevent torn JSON
features.counter_case: Adds complexity to cache save. Torn JSON only happens on crash during write. Acceptable without this for a dev tool; required for long-running MCP server.

features.name: git sortByChanges: order context pack files by churn frequency (most-changed last)
features.counter_case: Most-changed files may be boilerplate (migrations, lock files). Churn count without content-type filter may invert the desired attention ordering.

features.name: Remote config trust gate: skip local repomix.config.* in remote mode unless --remote-trust-config
features.counter_case: Adds a required flag for trusted remote repos. Power users will always need --remote-trust-config and may find it friction. Default-secure is the right call though.

features.name: secretlint profiler O(n²) fix: performance.mark no-op in worker threads
features.counter_case: Patches a private Node.js built-in. A future Node.js version could make performance non-configurable and silently drop the fix. The isMainThread guard limits blast radius.

features.name: Content-addressed token count cache: key = encoding:byteLength:md5_16 chars
features.counter_case: Token counting is rare in Cortex today (context packs only). Build this when pack performance actually matters at scale (multi-hundred-file repos).

features.name: Markdown backtick delimiter auto-calculation: max(3, maxBackticks+1) to avoid code fence conflicts
features.counter_case: Only matters when a file contains triple-backtick code blocks. Rare in knowledge entities but common in README files included in context packs.

features.name: Chunk separator ⋮---- between non-adjacent AST captures
features.counter_case: Unicode character may not render in all terminals or LLM completions. Consider `// ... (omitted) ...` as a plain-text fallback.

features.name: Lazy language parser singleton with explicit dispose()
features.counter_case: Singleton lifetimes complicate testing. Use dependency injection in tests; reset the singleton via exported __reset function.

features.name: for...in instead of Object.entries for loading large JSON cache (avoids 100k-tuple array)
features.counter_case: Micro-optimization only matters at 100k+ entries. Cortex's cache won't hit this soon. Use Object.entries until profiling shows otherwise.

features.name: JSON5 config format support (comments, trailing commas in cortex.json)
features.counter_case: JSON5 adds a dependency and surprises users who expect plain JSON. JSONC (comments only, no trailing commas) is more widely understood.

features.name: Duplicate chunk resolution: at same startRow, keep chunk with most content
features.counter_case: Most content is not always most informative. A short type annotation may be more useful than a long body block at the same row.

features.name: Adjacent chunk merging: join chunks where endRow+1 == next.startRow
features.counter_case: Adjacent merging may combine structurally unrelated nodes that happen to be on consecutive lines. Row-adjacency is syntactic, not semantic.

features.name: Tech stack detection from dependency files (package.json, pyproject.toml, go.mod, Cargo.toml, etc.)
features.counter_case: Cortex already reads dependency files during ingest. Building a separate detector duplicates work already done by synthesis. Better: extract from existing entities.

features.notes: Phase 7.10 (Sensitive Data Sanitization Guardrail) covers this

features.notes: Phase 13.5 (Fuzzy Levenshtein & RRF Search Ranker) is done

features.name: Handlebars template for output generation
features.notes: Cortex uses LLM synthesis, not static templates. Cortex generates richer, context-aware output.

features.name: Skill generation (SKILL.md + reference files format)
features.notes: Cortex has richer entity model. Repomix's skill gen is flat file packing; Cortex generates structured knowledge graphs.

features.name: GitHub archive streaming with exponential backoff (remote repo download)
features.notes: Violates local-first principle. Phase 22 server mode would need this, but that's a deferred phase.

features.name: Split output into N parts by top-level directory groups
features.notes: Cortex context packs are purpose-built selections, not whole-repo dumps. Split output doesn't apply to the knowledge graph architecture.

features.name: Tinypool unified worker in bundled environments
features.notes: Implementation detail for npm packaging. Cortex doesn't bundle yet.
